info.prompt: A cinematic overhead shot captures the precise moment when three wild tiles trigger the Wild Scatter event—bioluminescent rainbow rings erupt from each W-marked tile as every matching face across the obsidian neural core board shatters into prismatic particles, the shockwave distorting the surrounding skeletal gold UI framework while arterial crimson energy trails writhe like living veins, frozen mid-animation by a Dutch angle that emphasizes the cascading destruction against void black negative space pulsing with hacker-green datastreams.
